root_cause: The self-hosted Windows runner for the 'NPU Models Tests / 6010' job lost outbound connectivity to the GitHub Actions artifact/blob-storage endpoint after all tests had already completed successfully (4 passed, 7 skipped). The artifact content itself uploaded fine (SHA256 digest logged), but the final 'FinalizeArtifact' API call was refused (ECONNREFUSED), marking the job (and consequently the overall merge-queue status gate) as failed even though the test suite itself passed. This is a transient self-hosted-runner network connectivity issue, not a code or test regression, and matches a recurring known pattern (pattern 0c33a04c2cbe783c, previously seen on PR #36902).
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible outside CI; failure is caused by a transient network blip on the self-hosted Windows runner's connection to the GitHub Actions artifact service during the FinalizeArtifact call, after all test steps already completed successfully.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs for this workflow run; the underlying test suite already passed and only the artifact finalization step failed.

If ECONNREFUSED errors on FinalizeArtifact/ListArtifacts recur frequently for self-hosted Windows runners, escalate to the CI infrastructure team to check network egress/firewall rules for the artifact/blob-storage endpoints from the aks-runners pool.
prevention_strategies: Consider adding automatic retry/backoff around actions/upload-artifact's FinalizeArtifact call for self-hosted runners, or monitor self-hosted runner network health checks so transient connectivity blips do not fail otherwise-passing test jobs.
historical_context: This exact signature (Failed to FinalizeArtifact: Unable to make request: ECONNREFUSED) was previously recorded once on 2026-07-16 for a JAX Layer Tests job on PR #36902 (run 29495320592). This is the second occurrence, now on the NPU Models Tests job for PR #38168, confirming this is a recurring, transient self-hosted-runner network issue rather than a one-off event.
